offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based payroll, human capital management and workforce software to mid-sized US employers. Delivers it as a subscription platform, with payroll processing, tax filing and implementation services bundled in.

primary_products.value: payroll software; HR management software; time and labor software; talent management software

primary_services.value: payroll processing; tax filing; benefits administration; implementation and consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: mid-sized US employers and their HR and payroll departments

end_markets.value: employers across industries; professional services; healthcare; manufacturing; retail

revenue_model.value: subscription: per-employee monthly fees for software access; transaction or usage fees: per-check and tax filing fees for payroll runs; service fees: implementation, consulting and benefits administration fees; interest or premiums: interest earned on client funds held for payroll taxes
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: builds and hosts its own HR and payroll software, sold to employers; service provider: runs payroll processing and tax filing for employer clients; financial intermediary: holds client funds and remits payroll taxes to government agencies
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: US national: serves employers across all US states

specialization.value: related lines: payroll, HR, time and talent software sharing the same employer customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales team targeting mid-sized employers; partners / resellers: accounting firms and benefits brokers that refer clients; online: web-based sign-up and self-service platform

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing and data privacy rules, regulators include the IRS and state tax agencies
